mainPoints.explanation: From Picchi's retouching style learning to Kaipai's auto-editing of talking videos, Meitu uses multi-Agent teams to replace user operations, outputting ready-to-use finished products and lowering the barrier to entry.
mainPoints.point: Meitu's eight AI products collectively shift towards "delivery-style AI," allowing users to directly obtain results without learning the tools.

mainPoints.explanation: Users can upload 3-10 sets of before-and-after photos to create an exclusive retouching model, or directly use presets from professional makeup artists to batch output retouching results with a consistent style.
mainPoints.point: Picchi achieves personalized style memory and borrowing through "Learn My Retouching" and "Learn Their Retouching".

mainPoints.explanation: By analyzing beats, sections, and emotions, MVLAND produces an MV in 10 minutes that would originally cost tens of thousands of yuan, solving the pain point of MV scarcity in the short-video era.
mainPoints.point: MVLAND deeply understands musical structures to automatically generate mood-matching MVs.

mainPoints.explanation: The author believes that Meitu is no longer just competing on generation speed, but taking responsibility for the usability of the final results, covering scenarios like retouching, talking videos, e-commerce, and short dramas.
mainPoints.point: Meitu's "AI Imaging Team" elevates the industry standard from "generation" to "delivery".

oneSentenceSummary: Meitu released eight AI products at its Imaging Festival, shifting its core logic from "making users learn tools" to "letting users directly get results," achieving "delivery-style AI" across scenarios like photo retouching, talking videos, MVs, and e-commerce materials through AI Agent teams.
originalTitle: 美图一口气发了 8 款产品，我挨个用完发现它们在干同一件事
summary: Based on the author's hands-on experience with the eight products released at the Meitu Imaging Festival, the article analyzes Meitu's latest strategic shift in the AI imaging field. It highlights Picchi (which learns personal retouching styles from user-uploaded before-and-after photos or borrows aesthetics from influencers), MVLAND (which deeply understands musical structures to automatically generate matching MVs), Kaipai (which fully auto-edits talking videos into finished clips), Meitu Design Studio (which generates a full set of e-commerce materials from a single product image), and RoboNeo (a tool for scaled short drama production). The article points out that unlike industry-standard AI tools that emphasize "generation capabilities," Meitu this time focuses on "delivering results." By building an "AI imaging team" composed of specialized Agents, it allows users to get finished products directly without learning complex tool operations. The author believes this approach of "making AI adapt to people and being responsible for the results" elevates the baseline of AI products from "generation" to "delivery."
title: Meitu Released 8 Products at Once, and After Trying Them All, I Found They Are Doing the Same Thing
